name: Reveal
description: A card with Reveal is face up

name: Eternal
description: The first time this Unit would be destroyed it is not, reduce Eternal by 1

name: Burn
description: If this Unit attacks, you lose HP equal to the number of Burn on this Unit and remove all Burn

name: Pierce
description: If this Unit attacks a Defense Stance Unit, excess ATK Damages your opponent, reduce Pierce by 1

name: Cleanse
description: Remove all Debuffs or prevent a Debuff being Applied, reduce curse by 1.

name: Paralyse
description: This Unit cannot declare an attack or move Zone. At the end of your turn reduce Paralyse by 1

name: Medic
description: At the start of your turn gain HP equal to the number of Medic on this Unit, reduce Medic by 1

name: Curse
description: Remove all Buffs or prevent a Buff being Applied, reduce curse by 1.

name: Infiltrate
description: This Unit can attack Protected Units. If it attacks a Protected Unit reduce Infiltrate by 1

name: Blind
description: If this Unit attacks, the target is selected at random. If it attacks reduce Blind by 1

name: Nimble

name: Debilitate
description: Unit cannot be Sacrificed, Tributed, or use its Effects. At the end of your turn reduce Debilitate by 1
